methodology.period: Jan 1 through Sep 30 in every year; merge-date calendar buckets in UTC.
methodology.cohort: All merged repository PRs, including ports/dependency automation, not unique fixes.
methodology.community_cohort: Merged PRs currently carrying community ✨, using the same label criterion for all years.
methodology.merge_timing: Calendar days from PR creation to merge; not issue-to-fix or shipping time.
methodology.older_ai_signals: Original-commit AI credits were not scanned for 2023/2024; null means unmeasured, not zero.
methodology.collection_dates: 2023/2024 records are newly collected; 2025/2026 retain the unchanged previous snapshot.
limits: Current labels can be incomplete or differ in historical application.
Different release cadence, PR mix, backlog clearance and contributor mix confound comparisons.
Observed growth or merge-time changes do not establish AI causation.
Public AI author/credit/review signals under-detect assistance and credits can propagate through ports.
No representative satisfaction, AI-only, AI-attributable regression or issue-to-shipped-fix rate is measured.
